en.headline: Observatory records 23.3 degrees, autumn's coolest morning
en.dek: The Observatory said 23.3 degrees by 7:30am was the lowest since autumn began, with a high near 29 degrees expected later.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a dry northeast monsoon was affecting Guangdong on Tuesday morning, and that the city had turned slightly cool. By 7:30am the Observatory had recorded a low of 23.3 degrees Celsius, which it said was the lowest since autumn began this year.

The forecast for Tuesday is mainly cloudy and dry, with a cool morning and sunny periods during the day. The Observatory put the day's high at about 29 degrees, under moderate to fresh northerly to northeasterly winds. At 8am it recorded 24 degrees and relative humidity of 70 per cent. By shortly after 9am the Observatory temperature was still 24 degrees, with humidity at 68 per cent.

The Observatory said winds would be stronger over the next day or two, with mornings staying slightly cool. From later this week into early next week it expects fine and dry weather, with temperatures rising gradually and a larger difference between day and night inland.

zh.headline: 天文台今早錄得23.3度 入秋以來最低
zh.dek: 天文台說截至早上7時半最低23.3度，是今年入秋以來最低，日間最高氣溫約29度。
body: 香港天文台表示，乾燥的東北季候風正影響廣東，本港周二早上天氣稍涼。截至上午7時半，天文台錄得最低氣溫23.3度，並指這是今年入秋以來的最低紀錄。
天文台預測，周二大致多雲及乾燥，早上稍涼，日間部分時間有陽光，最高氣溫約29度，吹和緩至清勁的北至東北風。上午8時，天文台錄得氣溫24度，相對濕度70%。上午9時過後，天文台氣溫仍為24度，相對濕度68%。
天文台展望，未來一兩日風勢較大，早上稍涼。本周後期至下周初料天晴乾燥，氣溫逐漸回升，內陸地區日夜溫差較大。
